jobs.occupation: Epic Owner (Project Manager) – Digital Manufacturing Solutions, GN Hearing
jobs.description:
**Would you like to manage digital initiatives that shape the future of manufacturing? We are looking for an Epic Owner (Project Manager) to connect people, technology, and business needs while delivering scalable digital solutions across our global manufacturing landscape.

**In the role of our new Epic Owner in the Digital Manufacturing Solutions team, you will manage larger digital manufacturing initiatives from early concept through implementation and value realization.

**The team you will be part of

**Digital Manufacturing Solutions is a newly established organization within Global Manufacturing. We bring together software development capabilities to create, integrate, and scale digital solutions across GN’s manufacturing landscape.

Based at our global headquarters in Ballerup, you will join an international and collaborative environment. We work closely with manufacturing sites, technical functions, automation specialists, and digital teams to develop connected and robust solutions that improve transparency, support data-informed decisions, and enhance manufacturing operations.

We are committed to incremental value delivery and continuous improvement. Using Agile and SAFe principles, we create transparency, manage dependencies, and build a foundation for future digital, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.

**Your contribution is appreciated and you will

**

• Manage digital manufacturing initiatives from scoping through development, implementation, and value realization

• Define the vision, business value, scope, milestones, and work packages for assigned epics.

• Act as SAFe Epic Owner and support the preparation and execution of Program Increment planning

• Align priorities, incremental value delivery, and expectations with stakeholders across Global Manufacturing

• Coordinate dependencies across teams, systems, platforms, manufacturing sites, and external suppliers

• Ensure transparent progress reporting, proactive risk management, timely decisions, and compliant delivery documentation

• Collaborate with Product Owners, Agile teams, R&D stakeholders, and manufacturing functions to refine roadmaps, support launches, and scale solutions across sites

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you

**

• Bring an educational background in engineering, IT, computer science, business administration, or a related field

• Have experience managing complex software, digitalization, manufacturing, product, or programme initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and dependencies

• Are familiar with Agile ways of working and may have experience with SAFe principles, including Program Increment planning and incremental value delivery

• Bring an understanding of software development, system integration, data flows, cloud technologies, or digital platforms

• Communicate proficiently in English and work well with stakeholders across functions, locations, and cultures to create shared direction and structured delivery plans

Experience with manufacturing, operational technology, automation, digital transformation, EU Medical Device Regulation, or FDA requirements is beneficial.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 3 December 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician (Parental Cover) – Material Receipt, QC
jobs.description:
Are you a detail-oriented laboratory technician with a passion for quality and compliance? We are looking for a skilled and motivated Laboratory Technician to join our Material Receipt team within Quality Control (QC) on a temporary parental leave cover until 30th September 2027.

**About The Team

**The Material Receipt team is part of QC and is responsible for the reception, registration, sampling, distribution, and lifecycle management of samples and materials that support manufacturing and quality control activities across Bavarian Nordic.

You will become part of a dedicated team consisting of 2 Scientists and 7 Laboratory Technicians, reporting directly to the Manager, Material Receipt. The team plays a key role in ensuring that samples and materials are handled efficiently and compliantly, enabling smooth operations throughout the organization.

As part of the wider QC organization, collaboration is highly valued. We support each other across teams when needed, and you can therefore expect to contribute to activities such as deviation handling, ad hoc assignments, and training of colleagues outside the team.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Laboratory Technician in Material Receipt, your responsibilities will include:

• Create, maintain and update routine and non-routine jobs in the LIMS system

• Receive samples from Production and external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) as well as receive and sample raw materials

• Aliquot product samples and raw materials, maintain reference samples

• Manage internal and external sample requests and supplier complaints related to materials and samples

• Ensure GMP and internal procedure compliance, and support continuous improvement initiatives within the Material Receipt area

**Qualifications

**We imagine that you:

• Are educated as a Laboratory Technician or have equivalent relevant education

• Have experience working in a GMP-regulated environment, preferably within Quality Control or pharmaceutical manufacturing

• Work in a structured and detail-oriented manner

• Are proactive and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously

• Possess strong collaboration and communication skills

• Are comfortable working in both Danish and English

**What join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, you will join an international and purpose-driven company dedicated to improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines. You will work in a collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues and gain valuable experience within Quality Control operations.

We offer a position in an engaged and competent team, where you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally. In addition, we offer:

• The opportunity to contribute ideas and be heard

• A workplace that values collaboration, professionalism, and strong collegial relationships

• Flexible working hours, health insurance, pension scheme, and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• Access to a massage scheme, fitness discounts, and an active employee association

• Convenient transport options, including bus route 70E from Humlebæk Station, and EV charging stations on-site

**Salary

**Annual base salary range: DKK 435,000 to 505,000 gross

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

**Ready for new challenges?

**If you are motivated by supporting quality and ensuring efficient sample and material management in a dynamic laboratory environment, we would love to hear from you. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your motivated CV and getting to know you better.

Please note that for this position, we do not support any relocation packages. Candidates must possess a legal basis to work and reside in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

jobs.occupation: Oliver Wyman – Senior Consultant- (m/f/d) – Stockholm or Copenhagen
jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**What You Will Do

**As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

**You will:

**

• Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.

• Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.

• Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.

• Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.

• Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

**Why join us?

****You can be your best here

**At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact

**

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader

**

• Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.

• Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.

• Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

**Learn and grow without limits

**

• Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.

• Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.

• Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

**

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

**Experience Rewards That Work For You

**

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

**Who can apply?

**We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

**Required Qualifications

**

• 3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

• Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.

• Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.

• Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.

• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

• Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.

• Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language

• Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

**Nice to have

**

• Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.

• CFA or equivalent professional certification.

• MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

**What we're looking for?

**Successful candidates demonstrate:

• Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.

• Strong ownership and accountability.

• Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.

• Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

**How to apply?

**Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

**What to expect during the interviews process?

**At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business..

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

jobs.occupation: Director, Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI)
jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner, Compliance Technology
jobs.description:
**Product Owner, Compliance Technology

**Hybrid - Copenhagen or Manchester based

• Tech department

• Reports to VP of Payments & Revenue Technology

**About The Role

**OrderYOYO helps thousands of restaurant partners get up and running online quickly and safely, while we scale fast across Europe. How we onboard, verify and protect those restaurant partners is what keeps that growth safe.

We're looking for a Product Owner for Compliance Technology to join our Payments & Revenue Technology team and own that area end to end: KYC/KYB, restaurant partner (RP) data governance, RP identities and merchant management. Your job is to make compliance something that speeds up our growth, not something that slows it down.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment. You'll work closely with the people who feel the impact every day, fix what blocks them now, and make sure the roadmap removes the root cause — with a dedicated engineering squad, working side by side with two fellow Product Owners covering Billing & RevTech and Payments.

**Role Mission

**Make compliance scalable and largely automated as we grow into new markets and volumes, so that we onboard restaurant partners quickly and safely, meet the requirements of our PSP and acquiring partners, and keep one trusted source of truth for who our restaurant partners are.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Get direct, regular feedback from our Sales and Onboarding teams, our restaurant partners, and our PSP partners' compliance operations teams.

• Be the escalation point for compliance issues: dig into cases yourself, unblock restaurant partners quickly, and keep stakeholders informed.

• Turn recurring issues into roadmap items, so we fix problems at the source rather than one case at a time.

• Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for Compliance Technology, and lead your squad through discovery, refinement and delivery.

• Ship in small steps, measure the impact, and adjust quickly as priorities change — tracking what matters, such as onboarding time, automated approval rate and data quality.

• Own the end-to-end onboarding and verification journey for restaurant partners, balancing a smooth experience with the controls our partners and regulators require.

• Own the restaurant partner identity model (legal entities, owners, users and bank accounts) and make sure other teams use this data consistently.

• Own the tools and workflows for managing restaurant partner data after onboarding, especially bank account changes and re-verification.

• Be the product counterpart to our PSP and acquiring partners on compliance: know their rules, anticipate upcoming changes, and build them into the roadmap before they become urgent.

• Combine third-party KYC, AML and fraud vendors with our in-house platform, from evaluation to integration.

• Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Finance, and the Billing & RevTech and Payments Product Owners.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• Experience owning a product with an engineering team, as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a closely related role.

• Experience with onboarding business customers, ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or payments setting.

• Experience working with PSPs, acquirers, or similar partners and translating their requirements into product decisions.

• A proactive mindset: you think ahead about partner requirements and future regulatory changes, and plan for them rather than react to them.

• Comfortable making good decisions with incomplete information, and preferring to ship something small and improve it rather than wait for the perfect solution.

• Able to prioritise hard when everything feels urgent, and explain why.

• Sees compliance as a way to help the business grow safely, and takes a pragmatic, risk-based approach.

• Gets energy from a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can change from one month to the next, and wants to grow with the role as the company and team scale.

• Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to align stakeholders without line authority.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• 3+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager.

• Experience with compliance products such as KYC/KYB, AML, or fraud prevention.

• Hands-on experience with KYC, AML screening, or fraud vendors.

• Knowledge of payments and AML regulation, such as PSD2/PSD3 and the EU and UK AML rules.

• Experience with onboarding across several EU markets and the UK.

• Knowledge of restaurant, hospitality, or SME SaaS.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• Ownership of a business-critical product area from day one, with a dedicated squad and room to shape how compliance works at OrderYOYO.

• A hybrid way of working from our Copenhagen or Manchester office, with flexible working hours.

• Close collaboration with, and coaching from, the VP of Payments & Revenue Technology, plus real room to grow as the team scales.

• Work across multiple European markets on products used by 16,000+ restaurant partners.

• Social events, an annual international summer party, and a discount on food ordered through our restaurant partners.

jobs.occupation: Strategic Projects Manager, Marine
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to turn strategy into action and help shape the future of Hempel’s Marine business?

**At Hempel, we’re on a mission to double our impact – and to get there, we need bright minds, curious thinkers and strong team players.

In May 2024, the Hempel Foundation – in agreement with the Hempel A/S Board of Directors – invited CVC Funds to become a minority investor in Hempel A/S. This partnership is designed to accelerate Hempel’s ambitious long-term growth strategy, both organically and through acquisitions.

Now, we are looking for a Strategy Projects Manager to join our newly established Marine Strategy & Marketing team.

Reporting to the Director, Strategy & Marketing Marine, you will play an important role in supporting the execution of strategic priorities across our Marine business. You will work across functions and geographies, bringing structure to complex topics, connecting people and perspectives, and ensuring that strategic decisions translate into meaningful business actions.

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure to our business, work closely with senior stakeholders and make a tangible contribution to the development of Hempel’s Marine strategy.

**Your opportunity to make an impact

**In this role, you will help drive strategic initiatives forward, ensuring clear priorities, effective collaboration and strong execution. You will combine analytical thinking with hands-on project management, working with colleagues across the organization to create alignment and deliver results.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Drive strategic execution – Support the execution of Marine strategic projects, ensuring clear priorities, governance, timelines and aligned processes.

• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration – Establish and improve ways of working and governance that enable better coordination across commercial functions.

• Lead projects from insight to action – Manage selected strategic projects, bringing stakeholders together and ensuring decisions, actions and dependencies are followed through.

• Turn insights into recommendations – Support market, customer and competitor analyses to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions and sharpen our strategic priorities.

• Create structure and momentum – Bring clarity to complex topics, identify what needs to happen next and help ensure progress across multiple initiatives.

• Contribute to the bigger picture – Be part of a collaborative, hands-on team connecting strategy, marketing and execution across Hempel’s Marine business.

**Could this be your next challenge?

**We are looking for someone who combines curiosity and analytical rigour with a practical, business-oriented mindset.

You enjoy solving problems, bringing structure to ambiguity and working with different stakeholders to move initiatives forward. You are comfortable switching between analytical work and hands-on project coordination, and you know how to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.

**You Will Ideally Bring

**

• A master's degree in business, economics, engineering, finance or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure problems, assess options and draw sound business conclusions.

• Solid project management skills, with the ability to plan work, coordinate stakeholders and follow through on delivery.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate analysis into concise and compelling presentations.

• A collaborative and proactive approach, with confidence working across functions, cultures and organizational levels.

• Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

**Experience We Imagine You Bring

**Typically, you will have 2–4 years of relevant experience from corporate strategy, business development, commercial, finance, project management or a similar role.

**In Addition, You May Bring

**

• Experience from management consulting, which would be an advantage but is not a requirement.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives, establishing structure and governance, and driving actions through to completion.

• A track record of analysing business challenges, developing recommendations and communicating them clearly to stakeholders.

• Experience supporting or independently managing cross-functional projects and producing analysis that informs business decisions.

**The mindset we're looking for

****You Are

**

• Analytical and curious – You enjoy understanding complex business challenges, asking the right questions and exploring different perspectives.

• Structured and solution-oriented – You bring clarity to ambiguity and know how to turn ideas into actionable plans.

• Proactive and driven – You take ownership, follow through and are motivated by making things happen.

• Collaborative and influential – You build relationships, bring people together and create alignment across different functions.

• Business-minded – You understand the importance of connecting strategic thinking with practical business outcomes.

**Ready to make an impact?

**If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your strategic and project management capabilities, work closely with senior stakeholders and contribute to the future direction of Hempel’s Marine business, we would love to hear from you.

Apply by clicking the Apply for Position button and submitting your application and CV in English via our recruitment system. The application deadline is 22nd November, 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

_At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other.

__We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

_At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work.  We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

jobs.occupation: Flight Instructor - sponsored CRI/SPA program - (Re)location DK, Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of pilots? Do you thrive in a dynamic international teaching environment with structured working hours? Then you might be one of three new flight instructors at GreyBird.

About the Position

This role offers a unique opportunity to combine flight instruction with classroom-based theory teaching, creating a varied and rewarding workday where your expertise truly makes a difference. The position is full time at our flying base in Aarhus Airport.

You can, as a flight instructor, expect to conduct teaching primarily in flying aboard the aircraft. Occasionally there will also be teaching in the classroom or in the simulator.

When you start at Greybird as a student you have high expectations of the quality of the education. Those are expectations that you, as a flight instructor, will help fulfill. This is both an exciting and challenging task.

The sponsorship

If you are not already certified CRI/SPA we will sponsor the education you need.

For that we expect that you have:

• 
✅EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
✅Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

• 
✅Meets the requirements of EASA FCL for CRI/SPA ME or IRI MEP

• 
technical and academic knowledge

• 
The ability to work structured and high level of quality awareness

• 
Experience in working with people

• 
The will to educate in a constructive and professional way

• 
A cooperative and welcoming attitude

• 
Basic knowledge in IT

Further more we offer:

• 
Set monthly pay according to qualification & seniority, pension and private healthcare.

• 
Predictable schedule

• 
Permanent base in Aarhus Airport

• 
Possibility to fly in most of Europe

• 
Individual and extensive introduction training

•

jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 01 April 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Re-advertisement: Multi-physics modelling of wetting–drying induced ground movement, landslides and coastal erosion

Research area and project description
We are looking for a motivated and talented PhD candidate to join our multidisciplinary research team investigating climate-driven geohazards affecting infrastructure and the built environment. The successful candidate will become part of the long-term Villum Foundation research programme Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE), bringing together researchers in geotechnical, structural, coastal and environmental engineering.

The PhD project focuses on developing a multi-physics platform to simulate the coupled hydromechanical behaviour of soil interacting with water in a geotechnical context. The overall objective is to establish a combination of numerical methods under the umbrella of multi-physics modelling to assess the stability of slopes and embankments subjected to wetting–drying cycles, changes in groundwater level and saturation, surface erosion from stormwater and debris, and toe erosion from waves in coastal environments.

The integrated modelling tool should describe the onset of slope instability, accounting for different hydroclimatic triggering factors (including variations induced by climate change scenarios), and the evolution of mass movement, considering large deformation. Therefore, different numerical methods may be combined, leveraging on the advantages of each approach for simulating a specific phase of the process. It is not the intent to develop new constitutive models for specific soil types, but it may be relevant to explore the use of meso-scale models for soils such as till and fissured clays, both native to Denmark. However, while the main application should be Danish soils, the numerical framework should be developed with versatility in mind to allow the assessment of climate-driven geohazards generally in urban and coastal regions.

Project description 
Applicants should submit a short research proposal (maximum 4 000 keystrokes) that demonstrates their understanding of the scientific challenge, identifies key knowledge gaps, formulates research objectives and hypotheses, outlines a possible methodological approach, and explains why their background makes them well-suited for the project. The proposal will be refined together with the supervisors during the PhD.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a BSc degree (180 ECTS) in civil engineering (or a closely related engineering discipline) and an MSc degree (minimum 90 ECTS) with a specialisation in geotechnical engineering, or computational engineering or coastal engineering, including advanced coursework in numerical methods, finite element analysis, and geotechnical engineering.

Further requirements:
• Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English are required.
• Applicants are expected to have experience in numerical modelling.
• Demonstrated programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, Fortran, C++, or a similar scientific programming language) are required.

jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for byggeri og Bygni
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Methods for design of biobased building enclosure systems with a regenerative environmental impact

Research area and project description
The objective of this Ph.D. project is to define methods for design of building enclosure systems following a paradigm for obtaining a regenerative environmental impact. The project aims to define a gated process for design of such systems and demonstrate its operationalisation in the actual development of building systems in collaboration with producers and companies in the building industry.

The methodological approach will be a combination of co-creation techniques where the Ph.D. student actively engages with the building industry to develop practical and useful design methods and workflows that leads to a regenerative environmental performance of building systems. The work is centered around the use of biobased materials in systems with longevity in terms of building physics. Concepts of circularity is expected to be a lever for this.

The background for the project is that the planetary boundaries are overstepped due to excessive environmental load from human activities which means that humanity has entered a zone of risk of deleterious or even catastrophic environmental change at continental to global scales. The main driver for this is the built environment that e.g. accounts for approx. 43% of all energy-related CO2-emissions. There is therefore an acute need to reduce the environmental load from the built environment to a level that enables the regenerative properties of the planetary ecosystems to reestablish the safe operating space below the planetary boundaries.

Qualifications and specific competences
The candidate must have a technical background in building science such as B.Sc. or B.Eng. or similar. Applicants must furthermore have a technical master’s degree or at least one year of master’s degree in building science, environmental performance of buildings or similar topics. Documented skills in application of life-cycle assessments for buildings, hygrothermal performance simulations, and computer programming is mandatory. Experience in heat and moisture measurements in relation to buildings is preferred but not required.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Position: Challenge-based Research in the Humanities
jobs.description:
The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry invites applications for a 2-year postdoc to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

In recent years, a set of overlapping but different concepts have been used to describe a more world-oriented direction of the research conducted at universities: applied science, mission-driven research, challenge-based inquiry etc. These concepts and methods take on specific forms when they are adopted in the humanities. From a sociology of science or history of science perspective, the postdoc is expected 1) to map recent years' transformation within the academy towards challenge-based approaches and specific initiatives in Denmark and the Nordic countries – with a focus on the humanities, 2) to map how Danish and Nordic scholars in the humanities themselves engage in and conceptualize research on societal challenges, how they cooperate with external partners, and what humanists themselves consider to be the possibilities and challenges of this type of research, 3) to conduct an individual research project within this area, and 4) to contribute to the activities and events in the center.

The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry is an innovative and ambitious center of advanced study that fosters new ways of doing humanities research. The center has been established in a collaboration between the faculties of the Humanities at the University of Copenhagen and the University of Southern Denmark with the generous support of the A.P. Møller Foundation. Over the course of the next six years, the center will each year gather a group of scholars at the two universities to marshal insights from the humanities and develop new perspectives, nuances, frames, and narratives for one of the many local and global societal challenges such as, for example, inequality, war, health, artificial intelligence, or the climate crisis. 

A more detailed description of the center and its mission can be found here

Please read more about the position here

join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

• 
have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the interaction technology and AI engineering research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

• 
Human-Computer Interaction and Design

• 
Interactive Systems Engineering

• 
AI-based User Interface Technology (e.g. generative user interfaces)

• 
Human-AI collaboration (e.g. robotics)

• 
Human-Centred Technology Ethics and Human-Centred AI Ethics

• 
Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

• 
Domain-oriented Interaction Technology (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing)

• 
User Interaction Technologies (e.g., augmented reality and wearable technology)

• 
AI Engineering (e.g. multi-modal machine learning)

• 
Domain-oriented AI Engineering (e.g., medical, energy or manufacturing).

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as CHI (Human Factors in Computing Systems), DIS (Designing Interactive Systems), CSCW (Computer-Supported Cooperative Work), NordiCHI, UIST (User Interface Software & Technology), IUI, HRI (Human-Robot Interaction), TEI (Tangible Embedded Embodied Interaction), IDC (Interaction Design & Children), UbiComp (Ubiquitous Computing), PerCom, EICS, AAAI, WWW, ACM CIKM; and in journals such as IMWUT and IEEE TASE. If your work is more domain oriented and you therefore publish in leading venues within a specific domain, you are also very welcome to apply.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in human-computer interaction, artificial intelligence, software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship.

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

Hear about the vision behind SDU Vejle - and why you as a researcher should consider joining the journey.

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

• 
Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

• 
Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

• 
Noura Lena Howell: nouh@mmmi.sdu.dk

• 
Aparna Varde: apva@mmmi.sdu.dk

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

• 
Cover letter.

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

• 
A research statement.

• 
For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

• 
For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

• 
Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected.

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET).

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.occupation: Kok til thailandsk køkken  /  Chef to Thai cuisine
jobs.description:
Kok til thailandsk køkken

Brænder du for det autentiske thailandske køkken, og trives du i et travlt og velorganiseret køkken med høje kvalitetskrav? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Thai Wok i Valby har vi i over 20 år lavet frisklavet, velsmagende thaimad til vores mange faste kunder. Vi søger nu en dygtig og selvstændig kok til at indgå i vores faste køkkenteam.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

• 
Tilberedning af autentiske thailandske retter fra bunden (herunder wokretter, karryretter, supper og forretter) efter vores opskrifter og standarder.

• 
Klargøring af de friske råvarer, forberedelse af saucer og forretter, samt tilsmagning.

• 
Varemodtagelse, kvalitetskontrol af råvarer samt medansvar for lagerstyring og bestilling.

• 
Opretholdelse af høj hygiejnestandard og egenkontrol i henhold til Fødevarestyrelsens regler.

• 
Samarbejde med det øvrige køkkenpersonale om en effektiv og god arbejdsdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• 
Har solid praktisk erfaring som kok – gerne med speciale i eller indgående kendskab til det thailandske/asiatiske køkken.

• 
Kan bevare overblikket og det gode humør, når der er travlt i aften- og weekendtimerne.

• 
Arbejder struktureret, hygiejnisk og sætter en ære i, at hver eneste ret forlader køkkenet i høj kvalitet.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og en god holdspiller.

• 
Taler og forstår enten dansk, engelsk eller thai.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
En fast fuldtidsstilling (40 timer om ugen) i en veletableret og sund virksomhed.

• 
En uformel og venlig arbejdsplads med erfarne kollegaer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende vilkår.

• 
Arbejdstider primært i eftermiddags- og aftentimerne samt weekender efter fast vagtplan.

--

Chef to Thai cuisine

Are you passionate about authentic Thai cuisine, and do you thrive in a busy and well-organized kitchen with high quality standards? Then maybe it's you we're looking for!

At Thai Wok in Valby, we have been preparing fresh, delicious Thai food for our many regular customers for over 20 years. We are now looking for a skilled and independent chef to join our permanent kitchen team.

Your primary tasks:

Cooking authentic Thai dishes from scratch (including stir-fries, curries, soups and starters) according to our recipes and standards.

Preparation of the fresh ingredients, preparation of sauces and starters, as well as flavouring.

Goods receipt, quality control of raw materials and co-responsibility for stock management and ordering.

Maintenance of high hygiene standards and self-control in accordance with the regulations of the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration.

Cooperation with the other kitchen staff for an efficient and good working day.

We imagine that you:

Has solid practical experience as a chef - preferably with a specialization in or in-depth knowledge of Thai/Asian cuisine.

Can maintain an overview and a good mood when it is busy in the evening and weekend hours.

Works in a structured, hygienic manner and takes pride in the fact that each and every dish leaves the kitchen in high quality.

Is stable in meetings, aware of responsibility and a good team player.

Speaks and understands either Danish, English or Thai.

We offer:

A permanent full-time position (40 hours per week) in a well-established and healthy company.

An informal and friendly workplace with experienced colleagues, where we help each other.

Salary according to qualifications and applicable conditions.

Working hours primarily in the afternoon and evening hours and weekends according to a fixed shift schedule.
